articles.title_en: A Ukrainian attack on a Russian missile plant killed at least seven civilians. Locals say they had nowhere to hide.
articles.lead_en: On March 10, the Russian border city of Bryansk suffered its deadliest attack since the start of the full-scale war against Ukraine. Ukrainian forces struck the Kremniy El microelectronics plant, also damaging a nearby technical college and several residential buildings.
